proposals.title: test: nightly grade_thematic produces falsifier_evaluations.jsonl (idempotent)
proposals.rationale: The falsifier_honesty sensor is blocked because falsifier_evaluations.jsonl is absent. This test exercises the grade_thematic script (or a minimal stub) and asserts that the output file is created with the expected schema, enabling the sensor to begin accruing once real data flows. High-leverage: a single test unblocks the entire sensor.

A concise runbook ensures any operator can manually trigger grade_thematic if the automated job fails, preventing prolonged zero-observation periods. This directly improves coverage_health and falsifier_honesty by reducing the risk of inert pipeline.
